name: Warracker
description: Keeps track of product warranties, receipts and expiry dates

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Everything Warracker keeps: the PostgreSQL database (postgres), your uploaded receipts and files (uploads) and this install's own keys (secrets.env, uploads/.secret_key). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Warracker web UI and API, published on host as 6769

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
variables.description: The biggest file you can attach (receipts, manuals, photos), in MB.

variables.name: NGINX_MAX_BODY_SIZE_VALUE
variables.description: The same limit for the built-in web server. Keep it the same as MAX_UPLOAD_MB, with an M at the end, like 32M.
